rms_match_contract.definition: output = gain * raw_enhanced, gain = rms(noisy_input) / rms(raw_enhanced), computed once over the whole clip
rms_match_contract.silence_policy: zero noisy RMS returns exact zeros with an undefined gain; a zero enhanced RMS with nonzero noisy RMS is rejected
